title: ERNIE: Enhanced Representation through Knowledge Integration
summary: Yu Sun, Shuohuan Wang, Yukun Li, Shikun Feng, Xuyi Chen, Han Zhang, Xin Tian, Danxiang Zhu, Hao Tian, and Hua Wu submitted the paper 'ERNIE: Enhanced Representation through Knowledge Integration' on April 19, 2019. The paper described ERNIE as a language representation model using knowledge-oriented masking strategies, including entity-level and phrase-level masking.
significance: A documented publication milestone for the ERNIE language-representation approach described by its authors as incorporating knowledge through entity-level and phrase-level masking strategies.

verification.note: The authors' arXiv record directly supports the April 19, 2019 submission date, authorship, ERNIE name, and the paper's description of entity-level and phrase-level knowledge masking. This record is intentionally limited to the documented paper-submission milestone. It does not assert ERNIE's invention or system-birth date, institutional geography, universal priority, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationship edges.
